Tier: Default card tier copied into runtime instances
MinHealth: Minimum generated health inclusive or blank for runtime-composed cards
MaxHealth: Maximum generated health inclusive or blank for runtime-composed cards
MinAttack: Minimum generated attack inclusive or blank for runtime-composed cards
MaxAttack: Maximum generated attack inclusive or blank for runtime-composed cards
InitialKeyword: Initial battle keyword or blank for runtime-composed cards
AttackAudioDelays: Semicolon-separated seconds before each attack sound
AttackAudioVolumes: Semicolon-separated volume values from zero through one
HitDelays: Semicolon-separated seconds before each red hit flash
